title: UPDATE: Black Forest Labs Adds 4K Video and Cuts FLUX Upscale Costs by 50%
summary:
New integration on OpenRouter allows users to generate images starting at $0.009 each, with a dedicated video upscaler that has seen prices fall from $0.59 to $0.28 per second. Black Forest Labs also updated its FLUX 3 Video to support native 2K and 4K resolutions, pricing the service at $0.41 per second. These tools are now accessible on platforms including OpenRouter and Higgsfield, where the video upscaler is currently over 50% faster than previous iterations.

These additions expand the utility of FLUX 3 Image Klein, an open weights image model utilizing 5.6B parameters that is designed to run on one consumer graphics card. The model produces images in 4K and features bounding box layout control and pixel perfect editing. It is distributed via Hugging Face and integrates with the Diffusers library, including modular pipelines for distilled, non distilled, and NVFP4 or FP8r quantized checkpoints.
